trades.headline: Lamar Jackson sits on their bench every week while they start Josh Allen
trades.yourSurplus: Golden is Green Bay's WR3. The Packers paid Christian Watson $110.5M in June and extended Jayden Reed at $50.25M, and Watson opened at a 68% snap share to Golden's developing role. Golden has not started a week for you and would not start one behind Rice and Wilson.
trades.theirHole: Team 13 hold Josh Allen at slot 0 and Lamar Jackson on the bench at slot 20 in a one-quarterback league, so Jackson scores them nothing. Their flex is Travis Kelce because no third receiver clears him — Golden fixes that.
trades.yourLineup: Jackson takes the quarterback slot from Stafford; Tuten stays in the flex. Jackson declared himself fully healthy in September and his head coach called him in peak condition after an injury-hit 2025.
trades.theirLineup: Golden replaces Kelce in their RB/WR/TE flex. Allen is untouched at quarterback.
trades.risk: This replaces an earlier version of this card that asked for Josh Allen. That version was wrong: Allen is their starter, so giving him up costs Team 13 roughly 41 points of best-lineup season value and would never be accepted. The structural read was right and the named player was not — I did not check their slot column before proposing. Remaining risk: you would then hold three quarterbacks, which makes Stafford the next thing to move, and Jackson's 2025 ended with recurring soft-tissue injuries.

candidates.note: 29.8 points and 50% rostered, which is an anomaly in a ten-team league. Still not worth this league's waiver priority, which never resets — he is a flex competing with Tuten, not a starter filling a hole. He clears Wednesday 07:00 UTC. If nobody claims him, add him free.

Carried forward because it still stops a mistake. Hunter shows rank 1 in the data, which reads like the best player on the wire. He is not: Jacksonville list him as a starting cornerback and backup receiver, and he played four offensive snaps in week 1 on one designed touch. The rank is a preseason artifact. Never spend a never-resetting claim on it.
Downgraded again. Bowers is on track to return at the Chargers, which closes the target vacuum that made Tucker interesting after one week.

Irrelevant while you hold Lawrence, but the right shape for week 7 — when Tuten, the Jaguars defence, Cam Little and Lawrence are all out together on the Jacksonville bye. In this league that patch has to be a free agent, never a claim.
